anime.title: Alya Sometimes Hides Her Feelings in Russian
anime.description: Alisa Mikhailovna Kujou is a stunning, silver-haired high school student who maintains an icy, unapproachable demeanor to most. She sits next to Masachika Kuze, a seemingly unmotivated slacker. To express her hidden affection for him, Alisa occasionally mutters sweet, flirtatious comments in her native Russian, assuming her desk neighbor cannot comprehend a word. Unbeknownst to her, Masachika is completely fluent in Russian and secretly understands every confession. As he pretends to remain oblivious, a charming, comedic, and heartwarming dynamic unfolds between the two as they navigate their daily school lives and student council duties.

anime.title: Attack On Titan
anime.description: Humanity lives behind enormous walls to protect itself from giant creatures known as Titans. After a massive Titan destroys the outer wall, young Eren Yeager vows to eliminate every Titan after witnessing a tragic loss. Alongside his friends Mikasa Ackerman and Armin Arlert, Eren joins the Scout Regiment to fight beyond the walls. As they uncover the truth about the Titans, hidden civilizations, and shocking secrets about their own world, the battle becomes more than a fight for survival. Attack on Titan is an action-packed dark fantasy series filled with intense battles, unforgettable characters, emotional moments, political intrigue, and unexpected plot twists.

anime.title: Blue Lock
anime.description: After Japan's disappointing performance at the World Cup, the Japanese Football Union launches the Blue Lock Project, an intense training program designed to create the world's greatest striker. Three hundred of the country's most talented young forwards are gathered to compete in ruthless challenges where only one can emerge victorious. Among them is Yoichi Isagi, a high school player determined to discover what it truly means to become the best. As friendships are tested and dreams are shattered, every match pushes the players beyond their limits in a battle of skill, strategy, and ego. Blue Lock delivers fast-paced football action, thrilling rivalries, and the relentless pursuit of becoming the world's number one striker.

anime.title: Death Note
anime.description: Light Yagami is a brilliant high school student who discovers a mysterious notebook called the Death Note, which grants the power to kill anyone whose name is written inside it. Believing he can create a perfect world free of criminals, Light begins a secret crusade under the alias "Kira." As unexplained deaths spread across the globe, the enigmatic detective L launches an intense investigation to uncover Kira's true identity. What follows is a gripping psychological battle of intelligence, deception, justice, and morality, where every move could mean victory—or death. Death Note is widely regarded as one of the greatest psychological thriller anime ever created, delivering unforgettable twists and a suspense-filled story from beginning to end.

Tanjiro Kamado, a young boy whose family is slaughtered by a demon, joins the Demon Slayer Corps to find a cure for his sister Nezuko, who has been turned into a demon. Wielding legendary water and fire sword techniques, he fights the upper-rank threats of Muzan Kibutsuji.
anime.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba

anime.description: thrusts the Demon Slayer Corps into the twisted, ever-shifting dimensional fortress of the Demon King, Muzan Kibutsuji, launching the ultimate, action-heavy war for survival
anime.title: Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle Part 1
Jujutsu Kaisen
anime.description: Yuji Itadori, an athletic high school student, accidentally swallows a highly potent cursed finger of the demon Ryomen Sukuna. To save lives and maintain the balance of the Tokyo Jujutsu Shaman College, Yuji submits to Gojo Satoru's oversight to collect all fingers.

anime.title: Liar Game
anime.description: When Nao Kanzaki receives a strange letter and a suitcase containing 100 million yen, she learns that she has been selected to participate in the LIAR GAME. In this high-stakes psychological battle, lies, deception, and betrayal reign supreme. Naïve and honest, Nao turns to Shinichi Akiyama, a brilliant former con artist, to survive the twisted game. In a game built on lies, can honesty prevail?
A quiet loner and the popular girl at school find common ground, making their cosplay dreams come true.
anime.title: My Dress-Up Darling
Naruto
anime.description:
Naruto follows Naruto Uzumaki, a young ninja from the Hidden Leaf Village who dreams of becoming the Hokage, the strongest ninja and leader of his village. Born with the powerful Nine-Tailed Fox sealed inside him, Naruto is feared and rejected by many villagers. Despite loneliness and countless hardships, he never gives up on earning their respect.

Alongside his teammates Sasuke Uchiha and Sakura Haruno under the guidance of Kakashi Hatake, Naruto embarks on dangerous missions, faces powerful enemies, uncovers hidden conspiracies, and grows stronger through determination, friendship, and perseverance. His journey is filled with intense battles, emotional moments, unforgettable characters, and the pursuit of peace in the ninja world.

Naruto is one of the most iconic shonen anime series, known for its incredible action, inspiring story, memorable characters, and emotional storytelling.

anime.title: Solo Leveling
anime.description: Solo Leveling is an action fantasy series about Sung Jinwoo, humanity’s weakest hunter.

Master spy Twilight is assigned his toughest mission yet: create a fake family to infiltrate an elite school and prevent a political crisis. Adopting the identity of psychiatrist Loid Forger, he quickly assembles an unusual household. His adopted daughter Anya is secretly a telepath who can read minds, while his wife Yor is an infamous assassin living a double life. Unaware of each other's true identities, the Forgers must work together to maintain the illusion of being a normal family while facing dangerous missions, hilarious misunderstandings, and heartwarming moments. As their fake relationship slowly becomes a genuine bond, they discover that family is built on trust, love, and the willingness to protect one another—no matter the secrets they hide.
anime.title: Spy x Family

anime.description: Wang Ling is an extraordinary teenager who possesses overwhelming powers capable of destroying the world. To live a normal high school life, he constantly suppresses his abilities and avoids attracting attention. However, despite his efforts to stay low-key, strange events, powerful enemies, and supernatural threats keep finding their way to him. As Wang Ling navigates school life, friendships, and unexpected adventures, he must balance his desire for an ordinary life with the responsibility that comes from being one of the strongest beings in existence.
anime.title: The Daily Life of Immortal King

anime.description: Naofumi Iwatani, a young man summoned to a fantasy world to act as one of its four legendary heroes. Armed only with a defensive shield, he faces betrayal and false accusations early on, forcing him to rise from an outcast into a powerful defender.
anime.title: The Rising of the Shield Hero
Wind Breaker
anime.description: Welcome to Furin High School, an institution infamous for its population of brawny brutes who solve every conflict with a show of strength. Some of the students even formed a group, Bofurin, which protects the town. Haruka Sakura, a first-year student who moved in from out of town, is only interested in one thing: fighting his way to the top.
Two teenagers, a city boy in Tokyo and a girl in rural Japan, mysteriously begin swapping bodies, forging a connection that sends them searching for one another.
